section.content: 本发明公开了种锂离子电池，其包括电解液、阴极片、阳极片以及间隔于阴阳极片之间的隔离膜，阳极片采用的阳极活性材料包括Si或Sn或含有Si或Sn的合金，电解液包括非水有机溶剂、锂盐、添加剂以及由化学式(1)表示的含有不饱和支链的氟化环磷腈衍生物。本发明锂离子电池的电解液可在Si或Sn等合金阳极活性材料表面形成韧性较强的多层复合SEI膜，SEI膜在循环过程中不易被破坏，能够起到有效保护Si或Sn等合金阳极活性材料的效果，从而有效改善了Si或Sn等合金阳极活性材料的循环性能，也使含有上述电解液的锂离子电池不仅具有更好的循环性能，而且具有良好的低温和倍率性能。

The invention discloses a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery comprises electrolyte, a cathode plate, an anode plate and an isolating membrane isolated between the cathode plate and the anode plate, wherein an anode active material adopted by the anode plate comprises Si or Sn or an alloy containing Si or Sn; the electrolyte comprises a non-aqueous organic solvent, lithium salt, an additive and a fluorate cyclic phosphazene ramification which is expressed by a chemical formula (1) and contains unsaturated branched chains. According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery disclosed by the invention, a multi-layer composite SEI (Solid Electrolyte Interphase) film with the relatively high tenacity is formed on the surface of the anode active material, such as Si or Sn, of the alloy, the SEI film is not easily damaged during the recycling process, and the effect of protecting the anode active material, such as Si or Sn, of the alloy can be effectively achieved, and thus the cycle performance of the anode active material, such as Si or Sn, of the alloy is effectively improved, the lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte has the relatively good cycle performance and also has the good low temperature and rate performances.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The invention belongs to field of lithium ion battery, it is more particularly related to a kind of Si or Sn and its alloy anode Lithium ion battery.

Background technology

Lithium ion battery is current commercialization secondary cell state-of-the-art in the world, with electronics technology and electronic equipment Develop rapidly, electronic product is presented to the demand of lithium ion battery and increases situation rapidly, the discharge voltage high of lithium ion battery, High-energy-density and excellent low self-discharge characteristic are even more and are widely applied it.But, the hair at full speed of electronic equipment Exhibition, also the capacity and energy density to lithium ion battery propose requirement higher.

In order to further improve the energy density of lithium ion battery, cathode material and anode material with higher voltage etc. It is developed in succession, the application of particularly Si or Sn and its alloy anode active material has turned into a weight of lithium ion battery Want developing direction.But, alloy anode active material volumetric expansion in charge and discharge process such as Si or Sn is larger, therefore easily will The SEI films that its own face is formed are destroyed and cause anode material efflorescence so that the cycle performance of lithium ion battery is deteriorated, so that difficult To meet the requirement of practical application.

In view of this, it is necessory to provide a kind of Si with good circulation performance or Sn and its alloy anode lithium-ion electric Pond.

The content of the invention

It is an object of the invention to：A kind of Si or Sn and its alloy anode lithium-ion electric with good circulation performance are provided Pond.

In order to realize that foregoing invention purpose, inventor find after concentrating on studies：Fluorination ring phosphonitrile containing unsaturated side chain Derivative, its unsaturated side chain can be by chemistry or electrochemical action（The polymerization of unsaturated bond and electrochemical reduction）In Si or Sn alloy anodes surface forms the fine and close and strong organic SEI films of toughness, and the film can form a kind of constraint effect to active material, Greatly reduce active material because the structure that volumetric expansion/contraction is caused is destroyed；Meanwhile, fluorination ring phosphazene derivative main body Phosphorus nitrogen hexatomic ring by the covalent bond effect with the unsaturated side chain of other additives in electrolyte, in organic SEI films outer layer again One layer of more loose SEI film is formed, this layer of loose SEI film is all highly advantageous to electrolyte permeability, lithium ion conduction, but also can One cushion is played a part of with contraction to the volumetric expansion caused by anode material with cyclic process.By unsaturation The MULTILAYER COMPOSITE SEI films that side chain and phosphorus nitrogen hexatomic ring are formed on active material of positive electrode surface, can also effectively protect anode, Prevent it from continuing to be reacted with electrolyte, so that the decomposition of electrolyte is reduced, aerogenesis is reduced, and also just effectively reduces lithium ion The high temperature storage thickness swelling of battery, improves the heat endurance of lithium ion battery.Additionally, MULTILAYER COMPOSITE SEI films also have There is an excellent electrolyte permeability performance, and the good polarization led lithium ion performance, thus greatly reduce battery, especially Be under the conditions of low temperature and high magnification, its reduce battery polarization effect it is more notable, be effectively improved cryogenic property with times Rate performance.

Accordingly, the invention provides a kind of lithium ion battery, it includes electrolyte, cathode sheets, anode strip and is interval in Barrier film between anode and cathode slice, the active material of positive electrode that anode strip is used includes Si or Sn or the alloy containing Si or Sn, Electrolyte includes non-aqueous organic solvent, lithium salts, additive and the fluorination ring containing unsaturated side chain represented by chemical formula (1) Phosphazene derivative,

In formula (1)：R1The alkynes base of the alkylene, alkynes base or halogen substitution that replace for alkylene, halogen；R2With R3 It is separately hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkyl halide alkyl, alkylene or haloalkene alkyl.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the R in the chemical formula (1)1Carbon atom number be N, 2≤ N≤5。

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the R in the chemical formula (1)1It is chain structure.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the R in the chemical formula (1)2With R3Preferably halogen.This is Due to the strong electronegativity of halogen（Relative to hydrogen, alkyl）Make phosphorus nitrogen hexatomic ring that there is stronger electrophilicity, while steric hindrance It is small and be easier to surface of active material formed SEI films.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the fluorine containing unsaturated side chain that the chemical formula (1) represents The mass percent that change ring phosphazene derivative accounts for electrolyte gross mass is 0.5%~20%, preferably 1%~10%.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, it is sub- that the additive is selected from vinylene carbonate, ethylene carbonate Ethyl ester, fluorinated ethylene carbonate, 1,3- propane sultones, succinonitrile, adiponitrile, terephthalonitrile sulfuric acid vinyl ester, sulfuric acid Asia second At least one in alkene ester.This is due to the fluorination ring phosphazene derivative additive containing unsaturated side chain being added with other Agent（Such as vinylene carbonate, fluorinated ethylene carbonate, 1,3- propane semi-annular jade pendants lactone, nitrile compounds and sulfuric acid containing cyano group Vinylene or sulfuric acid vinyl ester）When using simultaneously, they can simultaneously act on Si or Sn alloy anode surface of active material shapes Into MULTILAYER COMPOSITE SEI films, this composite S EI films will not easily by the swollen of Si or Sn alloy anode active materials in cyclic process Swollen and contraction is destroyed, and therefore, it is possible to play preferable protective effect to Si or Sn alloy anode active materials, and then is greatly carried Rise the cycle performance of Si or Sn alloy anodes.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the additive contains sulfuric acid vinyl ester, sulfuric acid vinylene In at least one.Its reason is：Fluorination ring phosphazene derivative additive containing unsaturated side chain and sulfuric acid vinyl ester or When sulfuric acid vinylene is used in mixed way, its effect is more obvious, can be with mainly due to sulfuric acid vinyl ester and sulfuric acid vinylene The lithium sulfate SEI films for containing and leading lithium ion excellent performance are formed in anode surface, and is embedded into the fluorine containing unsaturated side chain Change in the fine and close SEI film layers that ring phosphonitrile is formed, form the structure filled with lithium ion conductor in network structure, further increase and cause The lithium ion conducting performance of close layer SEI films.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the sulfuric acid vinyl ester and/or sulfuric acid vinylene account for electrolysis The percentage of liquid weight is 0.5%~8%.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the non-aqueous organic solvent is selected from carbonic ester, ether compound And aromatic compound.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the carbonic ester includes that mass ratio is 3:1~1:10 ring-type Carbonic ester and linear carbonate；Cyclic carbonate is the one kind or several in ethylene carbonate, propylene carbonate ester, butylene Kind；Linear carbonate is dimethyl carbonate, diethyl carbonate, methyl ethyl carbonate, dipropyl carbonate, methyl propyl carbonate, carbonic acid first One or more in isopropyl ester, carbonic acid first butyl ester, butylene carbonate.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the ether compound includes ether compound and halo ethers Compound；The ether compound is selected from butyl oxide, dimethoxymethane, dimethoxy-ethane, diethoxymethane, diethoxy One or more in base ethane, tetrahydrofuran, dimethyl-tetrahydrofuran；The halo ether compound is selected from single fluorine two One or more in methoxyl group methane, single fluorine dimethoxy-ethane, single fluorine diethoxymethane, single fluorine diethoxyethane.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the aromatic compound is selected from toluene, fluorobenzene, adjacent fluoro first Benzene, benzotrifluoride, 4- toluene fluorides, to fluorine methoxybenzene, adjacent fluorine methoxybenzene, adjacent difluoromethoxy phenyl, the fluoro- 4- tert-butyl groups of 1- One or more in benzene, fluorodiphenyl.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the lithium salts is selected from LiPF6、LiBF4、LiAsF6、LiClO4、 LiBOB、LiDFOB、LiCF3SO3、LiC4F9SO3、Li(CF3SO2)2N and Li (C2F5SO2)2N one or more.

Improved as one kind of lithium ion battery of the present invention, the active material of cathode that the cathode sheets are used is selected from LiCoO2、LiNiO2、LiNi1-x-yCoxMyO2、LiFePO4、LiVPO4、LiMnPO4、LiFe1-a-bVaMnbPO4、Li2FeSiO4、 Li2MnSiO4、Li2FezMn1-zSiO4, wherein, LiNi1-x-yCoxMyO2M be Mn or Al, 0≤x≤1,0≤y≤1,0≤x+y ≤1；0≤a≤1,0≤b≤1,0≤a+b≤1,0 ＜ z ＜ 1；The barrier film is PE, PP/PE/PP barrier film, or is passed through Ceramics or PE, PP/PE/PP barrier film of PVDF treatment.

Compared with prior art, the fluorination ring phosphorus containing unsaturated side chain is with the addition of in lithium-ion battery electrolytes of the present invention Carbonitrile derivatives, therefore the stronger MULTILAYER COMPOSITE SEI films of toughness can be formed in the alloy anode such as Si or Sn surface of active material, it is this SEI films are difficult to be destroyed in cyclic process, can play the effect of the effectively alloy anode active material such as protection Si or Sn, from And the cycle performance of the alloy anode active material such as Si or Sn is effectively improved, also make the lithium ion battery containing above-mentioned electrolyte Not only there is more preferable cycle performance, and there is good high/low temperature and high rate performance simultaneously.

Specific embodiment

In order that goal of the invention of the invention, technical scheme and Advantageous Effects become apparent from, below in conjunction with accompanying drawing and Embodiment, the present invention will be described in further detail.It should be appreciated that the embodiment described in this specification is only to be The present invention is explained, is not intended to limit the present invention.

Embodiment 1

The configuration of electrolyte：Non-aqueous organic solvent ethylene carbonate, diethyl carbonate, propene carbonate are pressed 1:1:1 Mass ratio is well mixed, and adds the lithium salts LiPF of certain mass6, make lithium salt for 1mol/L, it is eventually adding with following knots The fluorination ring phosphazene derivative of structure formula, makes its weight/mass percentage composition in the electrolytic solution be 0.5%, that is, complete the preparation of electrolyte.

The preparation of lithium ion battery：

1. using as the LiCoO of active material of cathode2, the PVDF as binding agent and the conductive carbon as conductive agent with 95:2:3 mass ratioes are distributed in 1-METHYLPYRROLIDONE, by stirring, form cathode slurry；Cathode slurry is coated to negative electrode In current collector aluminum foil, dry afterwards and roll coated aluminium foil, then be cut into appropriate size, that is, form cathode sheets；

2. using as the graphite and Si of active material of positive electrode（Mass ratio is 85:15）, butadiene-styrene rubber as binding agent and As the sodium carboxymethylcellulose of dispersant, with active material：Binding agent：Dispersant is 96:2:2 mass ratio be distributed to from In sub- water, by stirring, anode slurry is formed；Anode slurry is coated on anode collector Copper Foil, is dried afterwards and is rolled Coated Copper Foil, then be cut into appropriate size, that is, form anode strip；

3. polyethylene separators are placed between cathode sheets and anode strip and keep apart cathode sheets and anode strip, then Naked battery core is superimposed or is wound into some way；Naked battery core is encapsulated in the laminated aluminum film bag of 6.2mm*58mm*100mm again In, after drying, inject electrolyte, that is, complete the preparation of lithium ion battery.

Battery performance test

Heat stability testing：The battery that will be prepared in embodiment 1~11 and comparative example 1~5, with 0.5C electric current constant-current charges To 4.35V, after then being placed 4 hours and 30 days at 85 DEG C with 60 DEG C respectively, the thickness swelling of battery, computing formula are determined For：Thickness swelling=(B-A)/A*100%, wherein, A is thickness before test, and B is placement at being placed 4 hours or 60 DEG C at 85 DEG C Thickness after 30 days.

Life test：At room temperature, will in embodiment 1~11 and comparative example 1~5 prepare battery, at 45 DEG C with To 4.35V, then constant-voltage charge to electric current is 0.05C to 0.5C constant-current charges, then with 0.5C electric currents constant current discharge to 3.0V, such as This charge/discharge 300 times, determines the capability retention of battery, and computing formula is：Capability retention=the correspondence of correspondence circulation is followed The discharge capacity * 100% of the discharge capacity of ring/circulate first.

Low temperature performance is tested：The battery that will be prepared in embodiment 1~11 and comparative example 1~5 at 25 DEG C in standing 5h Afterwards, with the electric current constant-current charge of 0.5C to 4.35V, then constant-voltage charge to electric current is 0.05C, then respectively at 25 DEG C and -20 10h is stood at a temperature of DEG C, then with the electric current constant-current discharge of 0.5C to voltage as 3.0V.The calculating of low temperature discharge capacity conservation rate is public Formula is：- 20 DEG C of discharge capacitance=- 20 DEG C discharge capacity/25 DEG C discharge capacity × 100%.

Discharge-rate is tested：Under 25 DEG C of environment, the battery prepared in embodiment 1~11 and comparative example 1~5 is put Electric high rate performance test：Constant current charge first with 0.5C carries out constant voltage and charges to electric current to voltage as 4.35V, then It is 0.05C.Then will charge to the battery discharge of 4.35V：Voltage is discharged to as 3.0V with the constant current of 0.5C and 2C respectively. The computing formula of 2C discharge capacitances is：2C discharge capacitances=2C discharge capacities/0.5C discharge capacity × 100%.

As can be seen that with the addition of the battery of the fluorination ring phosphonitrile containing unsaturated side chain, its low temperature from table 1 and Fig. 1~5 Performance, high rate performance and cycle performance are than the fluorination ring phosphorus without additive, addition saturation side chain or containing aromatic group The battery of nitrile is more excellent, and with being used in combination that other are added, battery performance can be made to be further improved.

From Fig. 5 and Biao 1, comparative example 1 is not added can be in the additive of Si/Sn anode surface film forming, with following The carrying out of ring, because the dilation of anode volume is very big, anode is not protected well, and material surface connects with electrolyte Touch, cause anode to be seriously damaged, thus the capacity attenuation of battery is very fast, at 45 DEG C, circulates less than 100 times, capacity is Less than 40% is decayed to, while its thickness swelling at 60 DEG C and 85 DEG C is respectively 61.2% and 82.0%, 2C and -20 DEG C Discharge capacitance respectively be only 56.4% and 19.3%.

Although comparative example 2-5 with the addition of can be fluorinated ring phosphazene derivative in the additive of Si/Sn surface filmings, Be, comparative example 4-5 additions be containing big steric hindrance with phenoxy group be branched fluorinated ring phosphazene derivative, and phenyl ring is extremely difficult Open loop, it is difficult to form long-chain SEI films in Si/Sn surface aggregates, thus the SEI films of densification can not be formed on Si/Sn surfaces；Contrast Example 2-3 additions are the fluorination ring phosphazene derivatives containing saturation side chain, and saturation side chain can not be formed in Si/Sn surface aggregates SEI films, it is advantageous to which P=N ring hydrogens are replaced by F, the strong electronegativity effect of F, make P=N rings have strong electrophilicity, easily There is electrophilic reaction on Si/Sn surfaces and form SEI films, because the toughness of SEI films is not strong, with the carrying out of circulation, additive is not Disconnected ground and anode reaction, are consumed, and ultimately result in anode and are destroyed, and battery life is very short, at the same the expansion rate of its battery compared with Height, discharge performance is poor.

Embodiment 5 is compared with Example 6, only the unsaturated side chain on P=N rings, and the former is ring-type, and the latter is straight chain, Cyclic linear ring-opening polymerisation is relatively difficult, and film forming is more difficult, and steric hindrance is also larger, and the polymeric chain of formation is long relative Shorter, the constraint effect of the volumetric expansion to Si/Sn in cyclic process is relatively weak compared with the SEI that side chain is formed, thus heat is steady Qualitative and cryogenic property is relatively poor.

Embodiment 3-11 with the addition of the fluorination ring phosphonitrile containing unsaturated side chain, and make together with reference to other additives With it is compared with embodiment 1-2, and circulation, low temperature and high rate performance are more preferable.Embodiment 4 is with embodiment 11 is added simultaneously The fluoridized ring phosphazene derivative in addition to unsaturated side chain, unsaturated side chain can form fine and close long-chain in Si/Sn surface aggregates Polymerization SEI films, fluoridized P=N rings are easily adsorbed in the SEI films that anode surface forms weaker zone due to its strong electrophilicity, And then MULTILAYER COMPOSITE SEI films are formed, the effect of being effectively protected can be played to Si/Sn anodes.Meanwhile, the sulfuric acid vinyl ester of addition with Sulfuric acid vinylene is excellent anode film for additive, good lithium ion conductive film can be formed in anode surface, with fluorine The polymerization long-chain for changing the unsaturated side chain formation of ring phosphonitrile forms densification, the SEI films that lithium ion conductive is good together, thus It has good cryogenic property and high rate performance, such as embodiment 7-11.The fluorination ring phosphonitrile of embodiment 9 not by perfluoro, Containing two methyl of supplied for electronic, the electrophilicity of P=N rings is more fluoridized weak, and steric hindrance is also larger, thus performance is slightly inferior In embodiment 11, as shown in 45 DEG C of cycle life figures in Fig. 5.

It can be seen that, it is anode activity material that lithium-ion battery electrolytes of the present invention can be obviously improved comprising Si or Sn and its alloy The cycle performance of the lithium ion battery of material, cryogenic property and high rate performance.

In addition, the lithium ion battery of the embodiment of the present invention will also store the thickness swelling of 30 days from more than 60% at 60 DEG C Less than 5% is reduced to, the thickness swelling that 4 hours are stored at 85 DEG C is reduced to about 7% from more than 80%.It can be seen that, lithium of the present invention from The use of sub- battery electrolyte substantially reduces thickness swelling when battery high-temperature is stored, that is, the heat for effectively increasing battery core is steady It is qualitative.
